=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- tests/test_audit_consumer_drift.py:1766 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The new pin-age tests added in this PR (lines 1520-1757) are not added to the `main()` function's test execution list.
  WHY: The CI job at `ci.yml:696` runs `python3 tests/test_audit_consumer_drift.py` directly and relies on `main()`, so the new tests would not run in that CI job and regressions in the pin-age alarm logic could be missed (source severity NIT).
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:102 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `review_head_gate_updater_exempt` duplicates the integrity status context string (`coding-workflows/workflow-integrity`) and the updater-branch regex instead of reusing the constants defined earlier in the file (lines 102-104).
  WHY: This is a maintainability risk: if the integrity status name or the updater-branch naming changes, several places must be updated, so the exemption check and the rest of the gate logic could drift apart (source severity NIT).
- .github/workflows/update_workflows.yml:2545 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: The `verify_head_gate` poll window (6 reads, 20 seconds apart) can expire while the `workflow-integrity` status is still missing or pending.
  WHY: The gate step logs a `::warning::`, exits 0 and leaves `ai-review/head-gate` in `pending` state, so the updater PR can stall silently until the next review run (source severity NIT).
- scripts/review_head_gate.sh:106-183 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite]
  PROBLEM: `review_head_gate_updater_exempt` trusts commit statuses (`ai-update-workflows/verify`, `coding-workflows/workflow-integrity`) without verifying the actor who created them.
  WHY: This is a trust-boundary gap, accepted as residual risk (fork heads and moved heads fail closed), but anyone with `statuses: write` access could in theory bypass the updater head-gate exemption (source severity NIT).
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
